5448.title: Flowchart HTML labels fail to wrap under CSS zoom
5448.rootCauseOneLine: Mermaid HTML labels compare scaled bounding width exactly with an unscaled 200px wrapping limit; CSS zoom skips wrapping and clips long labels.
5448.proposedFix: Repair dependency label overflow measurement in consistent layout coordinates while preserving HTML label features; verify physical display scaling before adopting an app workaround.
5448.caveats: Two clean trusted-main browser runs reproduce CSS zoom only. Physical macOS display scaling is unverified. Repro source and exact outputs are inlined; raw artifacts are not published under the reports repository policy. No simple-fix PR is safe without a capability decision or a dependency change.
